# Taylor McNeil

> Taylor McNeil is a Developer Experience Engineer, Technical Writer, and the creator of aampersand — a creative writing tool for fiction writers. Taylor writes dark fantasy romance under the pen name Aryn Wilder.

Taylor's professional work focuses on developer documentation, tutorials, and API design. The portfolio at taylormcneil.dev showcases technical writing samples alongside the builder's devlog for aampersand, a SaaS writing tool currently in pre-beta.

## Technical Writing

- [Introduction](https://taylormcneil.dev/): Portfolio overview and professional background
- [HMAC Authentication Guide](https://taylormcneil.dev/guides/hmac-authentication): Request-signing mechanism guide, originally written for NCR's developer platform
- [MongoDB x TanStack Tutorial](https://taylormcneil.dev/tutorials/mongodb-tanstack): Full-stack tutorial integrating TanStack Start with MongoDB
- [Java Game Development Tutorial](https://taylormcneil.dev/tutorials/java-game-dev): Building Tic Tac Toe in Java, from first principles
- [Stellar API Documentation Case Study](https://taylormcneil.dev/case-studies/stellar-api-docs): Case study on API documentation design
- [On Good Tutorials](https://taylormcneil.dev/case-studies/on-good-tutorials): Case study on what makes a tutorial effective, and how to write one

## Field Notes

- [Building Docs From Scratch](https://taylormcneil.dev/field-notes/on-building-a-doc-system): Reflections on building a bespoke, file-based documentation system on Next.js and MDX instead of adopting Docusaurus, Mintlify, or ReadMe

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is Taylor McNeil?**
Taylor McNeil is a Developer Experience Engineer and Technical Writer currently working at MongoDB on the Drivers Documentation team. Taylor is also the solo founder of aampersand, a creative writing tool for fiction writers, and writes dark fantasy romance under the pen name Aryn Wilder.

**What is aampersand?**
aampersand is a creative writing tool for fiction writers, built by Taylor McNeil. Write your prose, tag what matters, and see your characters, plotlines, and world — all connected. It is currently in development, with an open beta planned for October 2026. The product site is at aampersand.com.

**What is the aampersand devlog?**
The aampersand devlog is a series of technical essays published at taylormcneil.dev documenting the architecture and development of aampersand. Each entry covers a specific engineering challenge — database migration, annotation architecture, visual plotline tracking, and user testing — and follows a Greek mythology naming convention.

**Who is Aryn Wilder?**
Aryn Wilder is the pen name of Taylor McNeil. Under this name, Taylor writes dark fantasy romance (the seven-book Domains of Power series) and fanfiction on AO3. The author site is at arynwilder.com.

**What kind of technical writing does Taylor McNeil do?**
Taylor McNeil specializes in developer documentation, API guides, and tutorials. Professional samples include an HMAC authentication guide originally written for NCR's developer platform, a full-stack MongoDB and TanStack integration tutorial, and case studies on API documentation design and tutorial methodology.
